To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Internet is having a significant impact on Saudi society.
the Internet and the online communities it enables have the potential to be a powerful force for change in the Arab and Islamic world.
online communities have the potential to change people’s attitudes, behaviors and beliefs in the Arab and the Muslim worlds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social and cultural impact of online communities in Saudi Arabian society.
the impact of the Internet on Arab and Muslim cultures.
the impact of new media on the Arab and Muslim societies, and in particular, with the impact of online communities on the Arab and Islamic cultures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

online communities are changing the Arab/Muslim society in ways that were unimaginable a decade ago, and the changes that have been observed so far have been mostly for the better, and the changes to come in the future are likely to be even more positive.
online communities in Saudi society, as in many other societies, have both positive and negative implications.
online communities in the Arab and the Muslim worlds are affecting the lives of their members in a variety of ways, some of which are positive and some negative.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
online communities are a double‐edged sword for the Arab/Muslim society.
the Internet is a double‐edged sword.
the Internet and the online communities are changing people’s lives in the Arab and the Muslim world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online communities are affecting people’s lives and that the impact is significant.
the Internet is a powerful tool for social change in the Arab and the Muslim world, especially for women.
the Arab and Muslim world is not as homogeneous as is often perceived by the outside world.
